state_meaning: AI-drafted candidate; no person has reviewed it.
text: Sampling CriticGPT (RL only) critiques on ChatGPT training data a first annotator had rated 'flawless', the paper reports that when contractors reviewed flagged items with the critique, 24% had a problem that substantially lowered the rating, compared with 6% when a second contractor re-rated without critiques. Prioritising tasks with highly scored critiques raised the catch rate and lowered hallucinations.
title: Critic finds problems in 24% of ChatGPT data rated flawless vs 6% unassisted
